verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents assigning a public IP so a machine is reachable over the internet, and lists a private network as a feature to enable at machine creation; shared drives are described as accessible across machines in a private network. A user's report of hosting Plex servers loosely corroborates serving apps, but port and firewall controls and private-network setup are not documented in any depth. Missing for 10: documented port exposure or firewall/port-forwarding configuration, detailed private networking docs (subnets, inter-instance connectivity), and hands-on corroboration of private networking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking

citations.quote: Assign a public IP address to your machine to make it accessible over the internet
